metadata.title: Moody Chiaroscuro Portrait with Geometric Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast male portrait in a pensive downward gaze, utilizing extreme chiaroscuro lighting that leaves half the face in deep shadow. The background is vertically split into a cool blue and a dark navy, with a minimalist typographic block anchored in the bottom right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical split of the background mirrors the light/shadow divide on the subject's face.
The downward gaze of the subject directs the viewer's eye toward the typographic block.
The warm skin tones provide a focal contrast against the cool, desaturated background colors.
The rigid rectangular frame of the text box stabilizes the organic, soft-focus edges of the portrait.
coreInvariants: Extreme low-key lighting with deep blacks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The head is positioned centrally but slightly tilted, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bridge of the nose and the illuminated eye serve as the primary anchor, while the text box acts as a secondary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the illuminated forehead, moves down the bridge of the nose to the lips, and follows the chin line to the text block in the corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space in the bottom left and top right, created by deep shadows and the dark background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and black provide the atmospheric foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted cerulean blue on the left creates a cold, clinical contrast to the shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber and peach skin tones provide the only warmth in the composition.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast (light vs. dark) with low overall color saturation.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to blues, blacks, and natural skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Strict horizontal alignment within a thin-stroke rectangular frame

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a white outline box
Separated by a thin horizontal rule

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric sans for the primary name paired with a lighter, more organic sans for the secondary phrase.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider line between text tiers

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and modern weight of the primary text.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton for the lowercase display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man looking down, lit with dramatic chiaroscuro lighting. One side of the face is in deep shadow. The background is a vertical split of muted blue on the left and dark navy on the right. High contrast, cinematic grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin white rectangular box in the bottom right corner. Inside, place bold lowercase geometric sans-serif text on the top half and smaller, muted gold lowercase text on the bottom half, separated by a thin horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with deep blacks?
Is the background split vertically into two blue tones?
Is the text box positioned in the bottom right corner?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue background split
Warmth of the skin tone highlights
mustRedesign: Do not use the exact original wording
Ensure the text box is a clean vector shape

mustAchieve: Balanced distribution of shadow and light

postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth gradients in the shadow areas.
Ensure the text is legible against the dark background.
Verify the vertical split in the background is subtle but distinct.
Confirm the subject's gaze is directed downward and inward.
recipe.reuseFormula: Moody Portrait + Chiaroscuro Lighting + Vertical Split Background + Lower-Right Boxed Typography
